note: Human-owned classification of the closed-class auxiliary universe. The MACHINE owns the universe (grammar/compiler/aux-inventory.json, derived from the embedded UniDic); the HUMAN owns these labels, because UniDic carries no 'negation'/'politeness' feature — the grouping is irreducibly linguistic judgment. Every member of aux-inventory.json must appear in exactly one family here, and every member here must exist in the inventory; tools/test_families.py enforces both directions and HALTS naming any violation. Members are matched by (pos1, base_form); 'register' controls default widening.

registers.standard: Modern everyday Japanese; widened by default.
registers.formal: Modern but stiff/literary (e.g. まい); off by default, opt-in per pattern.
registers.classical: Bungo / classical Japanese; classified for completeness, never widened by default.
registers.dialect: Regional (Kansai へん/とる, Kyoto どす, etc.); off by default, opt-in per pattern.

families.name: negation
families.description: Negates the predicate. NOTE: negative ん/ぬ surfaces lemmatize to ず, so ず is the standard polite-negative member (行きません). The standalone lemma ぬ is the classical PERFECTIVE and lives in 'aspect', not here.

families.name: politeness
families.description: Addressee-honorific verb suffix (ます and dialectal/archaic polite copulas).

families.name: past
families.description: Past/perfective た and its classical ancestors.

families.name: aspect
families.description: Aspect /補助動詞 contractions (ている→てる, てしまう→ちゃう, ておく→とく...) and classical perfectives (つ/ぬ/り/たり).

families.name: desiderative
families.description: Want / want-someone-to (たい/たがる/てほしい).

families.name: causative
families.description: Make/let do (せる/させる/しめる).

families.name: passive_potential_honorific
families.description: れる/られる — one form, three functions (passive, potential, subject-honorific). Kept as one family because UniDic does not disambiguate them.

families.name: conjecture
families.description: Appears/seems/probably (そう-様態 and classical/dialect conjecturals む/らむ/けむ/ずら/べらなり).

families.name: evidential
families.description: Hearsay/inference (らしい and classical なり-伝聞/らし).

families.name: honorific
families.description: Subject-honorific / dialectal honorific auxiliaries (はる/しゃる/ていらっしゃる...).

families.name: benefactive
families.description: Do-for (てあげる→たげる, てやる→ちゃる).

families.name: permission
families.description: Permission/acceptability (てもいい's いい, as 形容詞/非自立可能).

families.name: attitude
families.description: Speaker-attitude marker with no truth-conditional content (vulgar/contemptuous やがる).
